name: Can you put crown molding in a small bathroom?

mainEntity.name: Can you put crown molding in a small bathroom?

acceptedAnswer.text: Crown molding can be installed in small bathrooms, provided the profile size matches the ceiling height. In a compact powder room or bathroom with eight-foot ceilings, an oversized crown molding can make the room feel cramped and heavy. Choosing a simpler profile between three to four inches adds an elegant finish without overwhelming the space. In bathrooms with higher ceilings, larger moldings can help balance the proportions. A key tradeoff is that intricate moldings in small, humid rooms require more frequent cleaning to prevent dust and moisture buildup in decorative crevices.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, crown molding works well in small bathrooms if you select a profile scaled to your ceiling height, typically between three and four inches for standard ceilings.
